z-m-03-01.title: Iphepha elide, elincane kanye nephepha elihlathiwe: liliphi elinendawo enkulu?
z-m-03-01.topic: Ukuqhathanisa indawo (ukubeka elilodwa phezu kwelinye, nokuqhathanisa namasikwele osayizi ofanayo)
z-m-03-01.goal: Qhathanisa ubukhulu bendawo bamaphepha amabili abukeka ehlukile ngomumo, ngokubeka elilodwa phezu kwelinye, nangokuqhathanisa ngezikwele ezilinganayo, ulungisa isinqumo sakho njengoba uqhubeka, bese uthi kudingeka enye indlela uma ukubeka elilodwa phezu kwelinye kungakanquli.
z-m-03-01.material: Kunamaphepha amabili anezinhlangothi ezine ezine-engela elilungile, '가' no-'나', enziwe ngephepha eliqinile. '가' kuyisikwele eside kusuka eceleni kuya eceleni, futhi '나' kuyisikwele esingasideli kakhulu futhi sigcwele kuno-'가'. Ufuna ukwazi ukuthi yimuphi omkhulu endaweni (usayizi womumo iphepha elimthatha). Awukayilinganisi ubude.
z-m-03-01.thinking.1: Ukushintsha ukuqiniseka kwakho njengoba kungena ulwazi olusha
z-m-03-01.prereq.0: Ukwazi 'obubanzi/obuncane' nokuqhathanisa izinto ezimbili ngokubeka elilodwa phezu kwelinye (izinga lebanga 1)
z-m-03-01.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi lwembulwa ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi. Isikhathi ngasinye, khetha ukuthi ucabanga ukuthi yimuphi omkhulu endaweni.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.hint.0: Esinyathelweni ngasinye, sho into eyodwa ngokuthi 'kuyafana kuphi futhi kuhluke kuphi' kulokho osanda kukufunda.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukusika ngempela amaphepha amabili uwabeke elilodwa phezu kwelinye, bese ulandelisa ngomunwe izingxenye ezivelayo.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Amaphepha amabili abekwe ngokuhlukana etafuleni futhi ubheka ngamehlo kuphela. '가' ubukeka mude futhi '나' ubukeka ugcwele.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Cabanga ukuthi yimuphi omkhulu endaweni njengamanje?
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Kunzima ukunquma ngendlela ebukeka ngayo emehlweni kuphela. Udinga indlela efana nokubeka elilodwa phezu kwelinye noma ukuqhathanisa ngezicucu ezilinganayo.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: 가 mkhulu. Ububanzi bude, ngakho ominingi ude mkhulu.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ubheke ubude hhayi kuphela ohlangothini olulodwa. Endaweni udinga ukucabanga ngobubanzi nokuphakama ndawonye.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Awukwazi ukusho ngokubuka kuphela. Kufanele uwabeke elilodwa phezu kwelinye noma uwalinganise.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uqale wacabanga indlela yokuhlola. Kuyisiko elihle ukwehlukanisa umuzwa nokuhlola.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: 나 mkhulu. Ugcwele, ngakho ubukeka egcwele kakhulu.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Unqume ngomuzwa. Kungase kube kulungile, kodwa awukwazi ukwazi ngaphambi kokuhlola.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Imiumo ihlukile, ngakho izindawo kunjalo zihlukile. Simane nje asazi ukuthi yimuphi omkhulu.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Noma imiumo ihlukile, izindawo zingafana. Asikabi nasizathu sokusho ngokuqinile kanjalo.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Ubeke '가' phezu kuka-'나' ngama-engela asekhohlo aphezulu efanisiwe. '가' uphumela ngale kuka-'나' ngakwesokudla, futhi '나' uphumela ngale kuka-'가' ngaphansi. Akukho owodwa ovala omunye ngokuphelele.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Uma owodwa ewuvala ngokuphelele omunye, ungasho ukuthi ovaliwe mncane endaweni. Kodwa uma ngamunye ephumela ngaphandle, kunzima ukunquma ngokubeka elilodwa phezu kwelinye kuphela.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: 가 mkhulu. Ingxenye ephumelayo iqhubeka ide ngakwesokudla.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ubheke ubude bengxenye ephumelayo kuphela. Cabanga nangokuthi 나 uphumela kanjani ngaphansi.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 나 mkhulu. Ingxenye ephumelayo ngaphansi ibukeka ijiyile.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kungase kubukeke kanjalo, kodwa awukaqhathanisi usayizi wezingxenye ezimbili ezivelayo.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Izindawo zombili ziyafana. Izingxenye ezivelayo zibukeka zifana kakhulu.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ukubukeka ufana akuyona isizathu sokusho ukuthi ziyafana. Zingase zifane, kodwa udinga ukuhlola kabanzi.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Awukwazi ukunquma ngokubeka elilodwa phezu kwelinye kuphela. Udinga nenye indlela.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Uqaphele ukuthi uma ngamunye ephumela ngaphandle ngemva kokubeka elilodwa phezu kwelinye, awukwazi ukusho ngokushesha ukuthi yimuphi omkhulu.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Emaphepheni womabili, kudwetshwe amaseli amancane esikwele alinganayo ngaphandle kwezikhala. '가' unemigqa emi-2 yamaseli ayisi-6 ububanzi, futhi '나' unemigqa emi-3 yamaseli ama-4 ububanzi.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Uma uqhathanisa ngamaseli, yimuphi omkhulu endaweni?
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.after: 가 imigqa emi-2 yamaseli ayisi-6, 나 imigqa emi-3 yamaseli ama-4, futhi amaseli alingana ngosayizi, ngakho bobabili banamaseli ayi-12. Ngakho noma imiumo ihlukile, izindawo ziyafana. Uma amaseli ehlukile ngosayizi, awukwazi ukuqhathanisa ngale ndlela.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Amaphepha womabili anamaseli ayi-12, afanayo, ngakho izindawo ziyafana.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uqhathanise ngokuthi mangaki amaseli onke uma amaseli elingana ngosayizi. Ucabange ngomumo nangendawo ngokwehlukana.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: 가 mkhulu. Kunamaseli ayisi-6 emgqeni, okungaphezu kwama-4.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ubheke umugqa owodwa kuphela. Udinga nokucabanga ukuthi kunemigqa emingaki.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 나 mkhulu. Kunemigqa emi-3, okungaphezu kwemi-2.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ubheke inani lemigqa kuphela. Udinga nokucabanga ukuthi mangaki amaseli emgqeni.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Uma imiumo ihlukile, awukwazi ukuqhathanisa izindawo ngokubala amaseli.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Uma amaseli elingana ngosayizi, ungaqhathanisa ngokuthi mangaki amaseli onke, noma imiumo ihlukile.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.reflect: Ukucabanga kwakho kushintshe kanjani kusukela lapho ubheka ngamehlo kuphela, kuya lapho ubeka elilodwa phezu kwelinye, kuya lapho uqhathanisa ngamaseli? Ukuqhathanisa ngamaseli, yini okufanele ifane ngamaseli?
z-m-03-01.s.s2.prompt: Umngane uthe, "Imiumo ihlukile, ngakho izindawo nazo ziyahluka!" Ungathanda ukuthini kumngane wakho?
z-m-03-01.s.s2.hint.0: Funa ukuthi ingabe kunesibonelo emaphepheni osanda kuwabona esenza umusho wakho womngane ubukeke ungalungile.
z-m-03-01.s.s2.hint.1: Qala ubhale ukuthi yiziphi izinombolo ongazisebenzisa njengobufakazi kuleso sibonelo, bese wenza umusho.
z-m-03-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubufakazi engibubhalile (inani lamaseli, njll.) ngempela ziyizinombolo eziphathelene namaphepha amabili?
z-m-03-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uthe 'imiumo ihlukile' no-'izindawo ziyahluka' ngokwehlukana?
z-m-03-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uthe nombandela wokuthi amaseli alingana ngosayizi?
z-m-03-01.s.s2.model.0: Bobabili banamaseli ayi-12, ngakho izindawo ziyafana. Noma imiumo ihlukile, izindawo zingafana.
z-m-03-01.s.s2.model.1: Ngikwazile ukusho ngokubeka elilodwa phezu kwelinye, kodwa lapho ngibala ngamaseli alingana ngosayizi, bobabili 가 no-나 bangamaseli ayi-12. Ngakho izindawo ziyafana.

z-m-03-06.prereq.0: Ukubala nokungeza izinombolo kuze kube ngu-10
z-m-03-06.title: Ngibheka phansi ngivela phezulu ngibona u-3, ngakho mangaki afihliwe ngezansi?
z-m-03-06.topic: Izimo ezibekwe ngaphezu komunye (ukucabanga ngezingxenye ongakwazi ukuzibona)
z-m-03-06.goal: Hlela lokho ongakusho ngokuqinisekile nalokho ongakusho ukubuka kuphela kusuka phezulu, bese wenza izindlela eziningi zokubeka ngaphezu komunye ezibukeka zifana kusuka phezulu futhi zinenani eliphelele lamabhlokhi elifanayo.
z-m-03-06.material: Imibhoshongo emithathu yakhiwe eceleni komunye ngamabhlokhi osayizi abafanayo. Kunowodwa ngakwesobunxele, owodwa maphakathi, nowodwa ngakwesokudla. Umbhoshongo ngamunye ubekwe usuka phansi, futhi umbhoshongo ngamunye unezendlalelo phakathi kuka-1 no-3. Ubheka phansi kusuka phezulu, ubona kuphela ibhlokhi eliphezulu lombhoshongo ngamunye. Awukwazi ukubona kusuka phezulu ukuthi zingaki izendlalelo zamabhlokhi ezingezansi.
z-m-03-06.thinking.0: Ukuhlukanisa lokho okwaziwayo ngokuqinisekile nalokho okungaziwa kokubonwayo
z-m-03-06.s.s1.prompt: Wazi kuphela umbono obheka phansi kusuka phezulu. Khetha konke ongakusho ngokuqinisekile kulokhu kuphela.
z-m-03-06.s.s1.hint.0: Hlukanisa amabhlokhi owabonayo namabhlokhi afihliwe ngezansi.
z-m-03-06.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ngokukodwa ukuthi isitatimende ngasinye siyiqiniso njalo noma imibhoshongo inamanani ahlukene ezendlalelo.
z-m-03-06.s.s1.r.a: Ubale kuphela amabhlokhi aphezulu owabonayo. Cabanga ukuthi kungase kube namabhlokhi amaningi ezendlalelweni ezingezansi.
z-m-03-06.s.s1.r.b: Leli yiqiniso ongazi ngokuqinisekile kusuka embonweni ophezulu. Bheka futhi ukuthi ushiye okuthile yini.
z-m-03-06.s.s1.r.d: Leli yiqiniso ongazi ngokuqinisekile kusuka embonweni ophezulu. Bheka futhi ukuthi ushiye okuthile yini.
z-m-03-06.s.s1.r.c: Unqume kuqala ukuthi wonke umbhoshongo unezendlalelo ezingu-2. Kukhona oshilo kanjalo?
z-m-03-06.s.s1.r.e: Izendlalelo ezingu-3 ziwubude obuphezulu kuphela obungenzeka, futhi kusuka phezulu awukwazi ukubona ukuthi yimuphi umbhoshongo onezendlalelo ezingu-3.

Izendlalelo ezingezansi zingahluka kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-3, ngakho isamba siphakathi kuka-3 no-9, futhi awukwazi ukusho inombolo eqondile.

z-m-03-02.title: Intambo ethiwe phakathi kwezipikili ezimbili odongeni: ubude bayo buyafana nakho?
z-m-03-02.goal: Thola umugqa ongalungile embonweni wokuthi izintambo ezimbili ezinokuqala nokuphela okufanayo kumele zibe nobude obufanayo, bese usho ukuthi yini enye edingekayo ukusho ukuthi ubude buyafana nokuthi ungahlola kanjani.
z-m-03-02.material: Kunezipikili ezimbili odongeni. UJia uthe intambo eyodwa engelulwa ngokuqinile phakathi kwezipikili ezimbili. UMinho uthe enye intambo engelulwa kuzona zombili izipikili, kodwa wayilengisa ukuze ehle phansi. Zombili izintambo ziqala esipikilini sasesobunxele futhi ziphela esipikilini sasesokudla. UJia wacabanga kanje.
z-m-03-02.prereq.0: Ukwazi 'ubude/ubufushane' nokuqhathanisa ubude bezinto ezimbili eziqondile ngokuzibeka ukuze ziphelele ndawonye (izinga lebanga 1)
z-m-03-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa ekucabangeni kukaJia oqala ukuphambuka.
z-m-03-02.s.s1.hint.0: Hlukanisa umugqa ngamunye ube yisiqinisekiso osihlolile ngamehlo noma umbono ophuma ezintweni eziqinisekisiwe.
z-m-03-02.s.s1.hint.1: Dweba bese uqhathanisa umumo wentambo eyodwa edonswe iqine nomumo wayo lapho ehla phansi.
z-m-03-02.s.s1.line.0: Intambo yami iqinile, futhi intambo kaMinho ihla phansi.
z-m-03-02.s.s1.line.1: Kodwa, zombili izintambo zilengiswe esipikilini sesobunxele nesokudla.
z-m-03-02.s.s1.line.2: Ukuqala nokuphela kusezindaweni ezifanayo, ngakho izintambo ezimbili nazo zinobude obufanayo.
z-m-03-02.s.s1.line.3: Ngakho noma sidonsa intambo kaMinho iqine, izoba nobude obufanayo nentambo yami.
z-m-03-02.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3 uphambuka kuqala. Noma ukuqala nokuphela kufana, ubude bungahluka kuncike ekutheni indlela iqondile noma iyaphambuka. Umugqa 4 isiphetho esilandela ukucabanga komugqa 3, ngakho iyiphutha elilandela. Imigqa 1 no-2 isho lokho okubonwe njengoba kunjalo.
z-m-03-02.s.s2.prompt: Intambo kaMinho nayo iyintambo engelulwa, njengekaJia. Njengamanje yintambo kaMinho kuphela ehla phansi. Yimuphi omunye umbandela esiwudingayo ukusho ukuthi izintambo ezimbili zinobude obufanayo?
z-m-03-02.s.s2.hint.0: Sho ukuthi yini ehlukile ekutheni izintambo ezimbili zilengiswe kanjani.
z-m-03-02.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola umbandela ngamunye ukuthi ubude bentambo bungashintsha yini uma lowo mbandela ushintsha.

z-m-03-02.s.s2.o.b: Zombili izintambo ziqala esipikilini sesobunxele futhi ziphela esipikilini sesokudla
z-m-03-02.s.s2.r.b: Lokhu sekunikeziwe. Njengoba ubonile esinyathelweni sangaphambili, ukuba nokuqala nokuphela okufanayo akunquli ubude.
z-m-03-02.s.s2.o.c: Zombili izintambo zilengiswe zaqonda futhi ziqinile
z-m-03-02.s.s2.o.d: Izipikili ezimbili zisemfuleni owodwa wokuphakama odongeni

z-m-03-02.s.s2.explain: Uma izintambo ezimbili zilengiswe ezipikilini ezimbili ezifanayo, uma zombili ziqinile, zombili ziyindlela eqonde kakhulu, ngakho ubude buyafana. Uma ngisho nenye ihla phansi, leyo ntambo ingase ibe ude kakhulu.
z-m-03-02.s.s3.prompt: Ufuna ukwazi ukuthi intambo kaMinho inobude obufana nobentambo kaJia yini. Bhala ukuthi ungahlola kanjani nokuthi ucabanga ukuthi muphi umphumela ozovela.
z-m-03-02.s.s3.hint.0: Cabanga ukukhumula izintambo ezimbili ezipikilini uzibeke etafuleni.
z-m-03-02.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi kwenzekani ezinhlangothini ezinye uma ulinganisa ucezu olulodwa lwentambo ngayinye yezimbili.
z-m-03-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe indlela engiyichazile ngempela ikhombisa umehluko wobude phakathi kwezintambo ezimbili?
z-m-03-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uxhumanise isizathu somphumela wakho olindelekile no-'ukuhla phansi/ukuqina'?
z-m-03-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ucabange ukuthi izintambo ezimbili zingase futhi zibe nobude obufanayo?
z-m-03-02.s.s3.model.0: Donsa intambo kaMinho iqine uyibeke eduze kwentambo kaJia. Ngicabanga ukuthi intambo ehlayo izoba mude kakhulu.
z-m-03-02.s.s3.model.1: Qondisa zombili izintambo, uhlanganise isiphetho esisodwa sazo zombili, ubheke lapho kuphelela khona esinye, futhi ungasho ukuthi ubude bungase bube bahlukile.
z-m-03-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Umphumela olindelekile mfushane, kodwa usho kokubili indlela nokungenzeka.

z-m-03-03.title: Uma usika iphepha lesikwele kanye ngokusika okuqondile, izingcezu zizobukeka kanjani?
z-m-03-03.topic: Ukuhlukanisa imiumo eyisicaba (ama-engela abukhali ezingcezwini ezisikwe ngomugqa oqondile owodwa)
z-m-03-03.goal: Thola imiumo yezingcezu ezimbili ongazenza ngokusika okuqondile okukodwa ngokubheka inani lama-engela abukhali, bese uthola futhi uchaze wena amacala amaningi angenzeka.

z-m-03-04.title: Amakhukhi enhliziyo nenkanyezi kufanele afakwe kuyiphi ibhokisi?
z-m-03-04.topic: Ukuhlunga imiumo eyisicaba (unxantathu, umumo onezinhlangothi ezine, imiumo yesiyingi nemiumo engekho kuzo lezo)
z-m-03-04.goal: Uma uhlangana nomumo ongenakuhlungwa emabhokisini amathathu, nquma kabusha izinga lokuhlunga, wenze umthetho wakho wokuhlunga, bese uwuchaza ngezizathu.
z-m-03-04.material: Isitolo samakhukhi sifuna ukufaka amakhukhi ayisicaba emabhokisini ngomumo. Kunamabhokisi amathathu: 'ibhokisi likanxantathu', 'ibhokisi lemiumo enezinhlangothi ezine', ne-'bhokisi lesiyingi'. Amakhukhi angama-2 anomumo wonxantathu, ama-3 anomumo wesikwele, ama-4 anomumo wesiyingi, ama-2 anomumo wenhliziyo, futhi i-1 inomumo wenkanyezi. Inkanyezi inama-engela abukhali angu-5 futhi imiphetho yayo yonke imigqa eqondile. Inhliziyo inomugqa ojikayo emphethweni ongaphezulu ne-engela elilodwa elibukhali ngaphansi.
z-m-03-04.thinking.0: Ukubona ukuthi izinga lokuhlunga lihlanganisa wonke amacala yini
z-m-03-04.thinking.2: Ukwazi ukuthi imithetho eminingi ehlukile ingenzeka
z-m-03-04.prereq.0: Ukwazi izimo zikanxantathu, ze-quadrilateral nesiyingi (izinga leBanga 1)

z-m-03-04.s.s1.hint.0: Landela umphetho wenkanyezi ngomunwe bese ubala ukuthi yenziwe yimigqa eqondile emingaki.
z-m-03-04.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa ikhukhi elibhokisini likanxantathu nenkanyezi, bese usho into eyodwa efanayo neyodwa ehlukile.
z-m-03-04.s.s1.o.a: Yenza ibhokisi elisha. Alifanelani namabhokisi amathathu.
z-m-03-04.s.s1.r.a: Ubone ukuthi ngesilinganiso samanje akukho ndawo yokuliyeka.
z-m-03-04.s.s1.o.b: Ibhokisi lesiyingi. Lincane futhi libushelelezi, ngakho libukeka njengesiyingi.
z-m-03-04.s.s1.r.b: Usayizi nokubushelelezi akusona isilinganiso sokuhlela izimo. Bheka imiphetho.
z-m-03-04.s.s1.o.c: Ibhokisi likanxantathu. Linamakhona abukhali, ngakho libukeka njengonxantathu.
z-m-03-04.s.s1.r.c: Ubheke kuphela iqiniso lokuthi linamakhona abukhali. Inkanyezi inamakhona abukhali angu-5, ngakho ihlukile kunxantathu.

z-m-03-04.s.s1.r.d: Ubheke kuphela iqiniso lokuthi linamakhona abukhali amaningi. I-quadrilateral inemigqa eqondile engu-4.
z-m-03-04.s.s1.explain: Inkanyezi iyisimo esizungezwe yimigqa eqondile engu-5, ngakho ayifani nonxantathu, i-quadrilateral, noma isiyingi. Udinga ukwenza ibhokisi elisha noma ushintshe isilinganiso.
z-m-03-04.s.s1.acc.0: Uma ubanzisa isilinganiso futhi uqamba kabusha amabhokisi, njengo-'izimo ezinamakhona abukhali', ungazifaka ngale ndlela nazo. Khona udinga ukushintsha igama elithi 'ibhokisi likanxantathu'.
z-m-03-04.s.s2.prompt: Khetha konke umthetho wokuhlela omuhle okumele ube nakho.
z-m-03-04.s.s2.hint.0: Zama ukufaka inkanyezi nenhliziyo emthethweni wokuqala, bese uhlola ukuthi kunebhokisi labo yini.

z-m-03-04.s.s2.o.a: Amagama amabhokisi mafushane, ngakho kulula ukuwabhala nokuwasho
z-m-03-04.s.s2.r.a: Amagama alula ukuwabhala kuyahlomula, kodwa kuyindaba ehlukile nokuthi umthetho uhlela kahle yini.

z-m-03-04.s.s2.explain: Umthetho omuhle unendawo yanoma yikuphi ikhukhi elifikayo (akukho okushiywayo) futhi uhlela ngendlela efanayo noma ngubani owenzayo. Ukuthi amagama mafushane noma amabhokisi amangaki akunqumi ukuthi umthetho muhle noma mubi.

z-m-03-04.s.s3.hint.1: Faka amakhukhi angu-12 eyodwa ngesikhathi emthethweni wakho bese uhlola ukuthi akukho khukhi elishiywayo noma elingena ezindaweni ezimbili.
z-m-03-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngomthetho wami, ingabe ikhukhi ngalinye lamakhukhi angu-12 lifaka ebhokisini elilodwa ngqo ngaphandle kokushiya noma yiliphi?
z-m-03-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi inhliziyo nenkanyezi ziya kuphi, ngezizathu?
z-m-03-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Uma umthetho womunye umngani uhlukile kowami, ingabe ucabange ukuthi lokho kungalunga nakho?
z-m-03-04.s.s3.model.0: Inhliziyo nenkanyezi akuyona unxantathu, i-quadrilateral, noma isiyingi, ngakho ngenza elinye ibhokisi elisha futhi ngizifaka kulo ngokwehlukana.
z-m-03-04.s.s3.model.1: Uma ngihlukanisa emabhokisini amabili, izimo ezenziwe yimigqa eqondile kuphela (unxantathu, i-quadrilateral, inkanyezi) nezimo ezinemigqa egobile (isiyingi, inhliziyo), inkanyezi iya ebhokisini lokuqala futhi inhliziyo iya ebhokisini lesibili.
z-m-03-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Kungomunye umthetho omuhle onamagama amabhokisi ashintshiwe.

z-m-03-05.title: Itheddi ngakolunye uhlangothi lomngani wami ngakwesokudla sami?
z-m-03-05.topic: Indawo nesiqondiso (kwesobunxele nakwesokudla kushintsha kuye ngesiqondiso obhekene naso)
z-m-03-05.goal: Chaza ukuthi kwesobunxele nakwesokudla kwami nokomngani wami kufana nini futhi kuphambene nini, unikeza isiqondiso obhekene naso njengesimo.
z-m-03-05.material: Kunetheddi etafuleni. Ngihleli ohlangothini olulodwa lwetafula, futhi itheddi lisohlangothini lwami lwesokudla. Umngani useduze naleli tafula, kodwa akakasho ukuthi ukuphi noma ubhekene nasiphi isiqondiso.
z-m-03-05.thinking.1: Ukucabanga ukuthi kubukeka kanjani isihlalo esihlukile
z-m-03-05.prereq.0: Ukwazi kwesobunxele nakwesokudla nokukhomba izindlela ngomzimba wakho (izinga leBanga 1)
z-m-03-05.s.s1.hint.0: Beka ipensela etafuleni njengetheddi, futhi njengoba uhleli, likhombe ngesandla sakho sokudla.
z-m-03-05.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ngokwehlukana icala lapho umngani wakho emi phambi kwakho nelicala lapho emi emva kwakho.
z-m-03-05.s.s1.o.a: Liseceleni kwesobunxele somngani wami. Umngani wami kumele ahleli ohlangothini oluphambene nami.
z-m-03-05.s.s1.r.a: Wacabanga ngaphambili ukuthi umngani wakho uhleli ohlangothini oluphambene obhekene nawe. Kukhona oshilo kanjalo?
z-m-03-05.s.s1.o.b: Akunakunqunywa. Sidinga ukwazi kakhulu ngokuthi umngani wami ukuphi nokuthi ubheke kuphi.
z-m-03-05.s.s1.r.b: Ubone ukuthi izimo ezidingekayo ukunquma azikanikezwa.
z-m-03-05.s.s1.o.c: Liseceleni kwesokudla somngani wami. Uma lisesokudleni sami, lisesokudleni somngani wami nalo.
z-m-03-05.s.s1.r.c: Wacabanga ukuthi umngani wakho ubheke ngendlela efanayo nami. Ingabe uhlolé ukuthi umngani wakho ubheke kuphi?
z-m-03-05.s.s1.o.d: Liphambi noma lingemuva komngani wami. Lihleli etafuleni.
z-m-03-05.s.s1.r.d: Uxubanise phambili/emuva nokwesobunxele/kwesokudla. Ukusho ukuthi ibhere lisohlangothini lwami lwesokudla kusho ukuthi liseceleni.
z-m-03-05.s.s1.explain: Kwesobunxele nakwesokudla kushintsha kuye ngokuthi umngani wakho ubheke ngendlela efanayo nawe noma ubhekene nawe. Uma ungazi ukuthi umngani wakho uhlezi kuphi nokuthi ubheke kuphi, awukwazi ukunquma. z-m-03-05.s.s2.prompt: Utshelwe okusha. "Umngani wami uhleli ohlangothini oluphambene lwetafula, ebhekene nami. Itheddi lisohlangothini lwami lwesokudla." Itheddi liseceleni kwesiphi sombango wami?
z-m-03-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ma ubhekene nomngani bese nobabili niphakamisa izandla zenu zokudla. Ingabe izandla ezimbili zisohlangothini olufanayo?
z-m-03-05.s.s2.hint.1: Uma ibhere lisesokudleni sami, thola ukuthi yini esohlangothini lwesokudla lomngani wami.

z-m-03-05.s.s2.r.b: Wahambisa isokudla sami ngqo waya esokudleni somngani wami. Yini eshintshayo uma nibhekene?
z-m-03-05.s.s2.o.c: Ngqo phambi noma emuva komngani wami
z-m-03-05.s.s2.r.c: Uxubanise phambili nemuva nohlangothi. Ibhere lisohlangothini lwami lwesokudla, okungukuthi, liseceleni.
z-m-03-05.s.s2.explain: Uma nibhekene, kwesobunxele nakwesokudla komunye nomunye kuphambene. Itheddi elisesokudleni sami lisesobunxeleni somngani wami.

z-m-03-07.title: Uma sibeka izinduku eceleni komunye ngababili ngesikhathi kuphela, singazi ubude bezinye ezimbili?
z-m-03-07.topic: Ukuqhathanisa ubude ngokungaqondile (ukuxhumanisa imiphumela evela ekuqhathaniseni ababili ngesikhathi)
z-m-03-07.goal: Hlukanisa amacala lapho ukuxhumanisa imiphumela evela ekuqhathaniseni ababili ngesikhathi kukuvumela ukuthi usho ubude bezinduku ezimbili ongazange uzibeke eceleni komunye, namacala lapho kungakuvumeli, bese wenza wena amathuba amaningi emacaleni angenakunqunywa.
z-m-03-07.material: Kunezinduku ezibomvu, eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, neziphuzi. Zonke ziqondile futhi aziqhelisi. Awukwazi ukubeka zonke izinduku ezintathu eceleni komunye ngasikhathi sinye, futhi ungabeka ezimbili kuphela eceleni komunye ngesikhathi. Sisho ubude benduku ngo-'inani lezinyathelo'. Ezinyathelweni ezingezansi, uzotshelwa imiphumela yokubeka ezimbili eceleni komunye.
z-m-03-07.prereq.0: Ukubeka izinduku ezimbili eceleni komunye bese usho ukuthi iyiphi ende (izinga leBanga 1)
z-m-03-07.s.s1.prompt: Uma ezimbili zibekwe eceleni komunye, kuthiwa 'obomvu mude kuno-luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, futhi oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka mude kunophuzi'. Obomvu nophuzi abakabekwa eceleni komunye. Yimuphi omude?
z-m-03-07.s.s1.hint.0: Beka induku eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka maphakathi bese udweba imiphumela yokuqhathanisa obomvu nophuzi ngamunye nooluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka.
z-m-03-07.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka lungu-5 izinyathelo, bese ubhala izinombolo obomvu nophuzi ngamunye abangaba zona.
z-m-03-07.s.s1.o.a: Ophuzi mude. Igama lakhe lifike ekugcineni, ngakho mude.
z-m-03-07.s.s2.o.b: Ophuzi mude. Igama lakhe lifike ekugcineni, ngakho mude.
z-m-03-07.s.s1.r.a: Uxubanise ukulandelana kokushiwo nobude. Xhumanisa imiphumela emibili oyitshelwe.
z-m-03-07.s.s1.o.b: Obomvu mude. Ungaxhumanisa ngoluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka maphakathi.
z-m-03-07.s.s1.o.c: Izinduku ezimbili zilingana ngobude. Ngoba oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka luphakathi kwazo.
z-m-03-07.s.s1.r.c: Ukuba nentonga maphakathi akwenzi ezinye ezimbili zifane.
z-m-03-07.s.s1.o.d: Awukwazi ukwazi ngaphandle kokuba ukuze uzibeke eceleni komunye wena.
z-m-03-07.s.s1.r.d: Ukukubona ngqo kuqinisekile kakhulu, kodwa kukhona amacala lapho ungazi khona ngokuxhumanisa imiphumela emibili oseyitholile.
z-m-03-07.s.s1.explain: Uma obomvu mude kuno-luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka futhi luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka mude kuno-mpunga, khona-ke obomvu mude kuno-luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka futhi luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka mude kuno-mpunga, ngakho obomvu mude kuno-mpunga. Yicala lapho intonga maphakathi isebenza njengebhuloho.
z-m-03-07.s.s2.prompt: Kulokhu imiphumela ihlukile. Kuthiwa 'obomvu mude kuno-luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, futhi mpunga naye mude kuno-luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka'. Obomvu no-mpunga abazange babekwe eceleni komunye. Yimuphi omude?
z-m-03-07.s.s2.hint.0: Beka u-luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka njengezinyathelo ezi-5 bese unika obomvu no-mpunga noma yiziphi izinombolo zezinyathelo ezi-6 noma ngaphezulu.
z-m-03-07.s.s2.hint.1: Shintsha izinombolo oziniketha obomvu no-mpunga futhi uhlole ukuthi uthola yonke amacala lapho ngamunye emude.
z-m-03-07.s.s2.o.a: Obomvu mude. Igama lawo laqala, ngakho mude.
z-m-03-07.s.s2.r.a: Uxubanise ukulandelana kwalokho okushiwo nobude. Emiphumeleni owatshelwa yona, ingabe kwakukhona okuqhathanise obomvu no-mpunga ngqo?
z-m-03-07.s.s2.r.b: Uxubanise ukulandelana kwalokho okushiwo nobude. Emiphumeleni owatshelwa yona, ingabe kwakukhona okuqhathanise obomvu no-mpunga ngqo?
z-m-03-07.s.s2.o.c: Balingana ngobude. Ngoba bobabili bude kuno-luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka.
z-m-03-07.s.s2.r.c: Ukuba bobabili bude kuno-luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka akusho ukuthi laba ababili bayafana. Bangaba nobude obuhlukene.
z-m-03-07.s.s2.o.d: Asikwazi ukunquma. Noma yimuphi ungaba mude futhi usalungile.
z-m-03-07.s.s2.explain: Uma wazi kuphela ukuthi bobabili bude kuno-luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, obomvu no-mpunga bangaba noma yimuphi omude noma bafane. Udinga ukubeka laba ababili eceleni komunye, noma ube nolunye ulwazi.
z-m-03-07.s.s3.prompt: Ugcina umphumela othi 'obomvu mude kuno-luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, futhi mpunga naye mude kuno-luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka', yenza amasethi angu-3 ahlukene obude bezintonga lapho kuhluka khona ukuthi yimuphi omude phakathi kwa-obomvu no-mpunga (noma bayafana yini). Ubude buyizinombolo zemvelo (inani lezinyathelo) kusukela ku-1 kuya ku-30.
z-m-03-07.s.s3.hint.0: Qala unqume ubude obuyodwa bentonga luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka. Obomvu no-mpunga kumele banqunywe ukuthi bude kunalokho.
z-m-03-07.s.s3.hint.1: Yenza isibonelo esisodwa lapho obomvu mude kuno-mpunga, bese ushintsha izinombolo zezintonga ezimbili ukwenza isibonelo esiphambene.
z-m-03-07.s.s3.hint.2: Bala nokulingana ngobude njengecala elilodwa. Esibonelweni sesithathu, beka obomvu no-mpunga kunombolo efanayo.
z-m-03-07.s.s3.ok.c0: Wonke amanani amathathu obude ayizinombolo zemvelo kusukela ku-1 kuya ku-30.
z-m-03-07.s.s3.fail.c0: Bhala ubude njengezinombolo zemvelo (inani lezinyathelo) kusukela ku-1 kuya ku-30.
z-m-03-07.s.s3.fail.c1: Obomvu kumele abe mude kuno-luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka.
z-m-03-07.s.s3.fail.c2: Mpunga kumele abe mude kuno-luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka nawo.
z-m-03-07.s.s3.explain: Isibonelo, uma (obomvu, luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, mpunga) kungu-(10, 5, 8), obomvu mude; uma kungu-(8, 5, 10), mpunga mude; futhi uma kungu-(7, 5, 7), bayafana. Kuwo wonke amacala amathathu, zombili izintonga zide kuno-luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, njengoba umphumela usho. Ngakho lo mphumela wodwa awukwazi ukuqhathanisa obomvu no-mpunga.

z-m-03-08.title: Uma ukwakheka okubonwa ngaphezulu kuyisiyingi, kungaba yinto yohlobo luni?
z-m-03-08.topic: Izimo eziqinile (ukubona amabhokisi, izimo zezinsika ezizungeze, nezimo zebhola ngokuhlukile kuye ngohlangothi obheka kulo)
z-m-03-08.goal: Sebenza ukuthi ukwakheka okubonwa ohlangothini olulodwa kuphela kungakwazi yini ukunquma into, nciphisa isahlulelo sakho njengoba ufunda ukwakheka okubonwa ezinhlangothini ezinye, futhi ubikezele ukwakheka uma ibekwe ngohlangothi.
z-m-03-08.material: Kunento etafuleni, futhi isikrini sifihla ingxenye yayo ukuze ingxenye ethile kuphela ibonakale. Le nto ingenye yalezi: isimo sebhokisi (esenziwe ngobuso obungamasikwele), isimo sensika ezungezayo (ezungezayo futhi eyisicaba phezulu naphansi njengethini), noma isimo sebhola. Ibekwe ume mpo phansi.
z-m-03-08.thinking.0: Ukucabanga ngawo wonke amacala angenzeka ngocezu olulodwa lolwazi
z-m-03-08.thinking.2: Ukubikezela ukwakheka okushintsha uma uhlangothi obheka kulo lushintsha
z-m-03-08.prereq.0: Ukwazi amabhokisi, izimo zensika ezizungezayo (amathini), nezimo zebhola (izinga leBanga 1)
z-m-03-08.s.s1.prompt: Izinhlangothi ongabheka kuzo ziyanda esisodwa ngasikhathi sinye. Isikhathi ngasinye, khetha ukuthi ucabanga ukuthi into iyini.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga ukubheka phansi kuzo zonke izinto ezintathu usuka phezulu futhi usho ukuthi ngayinye ibonakala kanjani.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.hint.1: Uma unethini langempela noma ibhola, libheke usuka phezulu nasohlangothini futhi uthole ukuthi yini efanayo nokuthi yini ehlukile.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.info: Ubheka phansi usuka phezulu, kubonakala njengesimo sesiyingi.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.after: Ibhokisi libonakala njengesikwele uma libonwa ngaphezulu, futhi insika ezungezayo nebhola kubonakala njengesiyingi uma kubonwa ngaphezulu. Ngakho ngalolu lwazi kuphela, kunzima ukunquma phakathi kwensika ezungezayo nebhola.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Isimo sebhokisi. Izinto etafuleni zivame ukuba amabhokisi.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Awuhloli ukuthi into ebonakala izungeziwe ngaphezulu ifaneleka kanjani ebhokisini. Ibhokisi libonakala kanjani ngaphezulu?
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Awuhloli ukuthi izinto ezibonakala njengesiyingi ziyodwa kuphela yini. Ezinye izinto zibonakala kanjani?
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Insika ezungezayo noma ibhola. Akubonakali kuyibhokisi.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ucabange ngawo wonke amacala abonakala njengesiyingi.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Zontathu ziyakwazi. Noma iyiphi into ibonakala izungeziwe ngaphezulu.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ibhokisi libonakala njengesikwele ngaphezulu. Akunjalo ukuthi zonke izinto ezintathu ziyakwazi.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.info: Ohlangothini kubonakala njengesimo sesikwele, futhi ingaphezulu nengaphansi kuyisicaba.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.ask: Manje ucabanga ukuthi into ingaba yini?
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.after: Into ebonakala njengesiyingi ngaphezulu nesikwele ohlangothini yinsika ezungezayo. Ibhola libonakala njengesiyingi nasohlangothini, futhi ibhokisi libonakala njengesikwele ngaphezulu.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Yinsika ezungezayo. Ngaphezulu ibonakala njengesiyingi, futhi ohlangothini ibonakala njengesikwele.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uhambisane nezimo ezivela ezinhlangothini ezimbili ndawonye.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Isimo sebhola. Bekuyisiyingi ngaphezulu, ngakho kuzoba njalo nasohlangothini.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ibhola libonakala njengesiyingi kuzo zonke izinhlangothi. Hlola ukuthi ifaneleka yini ukwakheka okubonwa ohlangothini.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Isimo sebhokisi. Ngoba kubonakala njengesikwele ohlangothini.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ubheke kuphela ukwakheka kohlangothi. Cabanga nangeqiniso lokuthi kwakuyisiyingi ngaphezulu.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Kuyisiyingi ngaphezulu nesikwele ohlangothini, ngakho asikwazi ukunquma into.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Awusebenzanga ukuthi zombili izimo ziyafaneleka yini into eyodwa. Yiluphi uhlobo lwento olunazo zombili izimo?
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.info: Le nto yalala ohlangothini futhi yaphakanyiswa ukuze ingagingqi.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.ask: Uma ubheka phansi usuka phezulu entweni elele ohlangothini, izobonakala kanjani?
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.after: Uma ilele, uhlangothi lwayo lubheke phezulu. Isimo sesikwele owasibona ohlangothini lapho yayimile manje sibonwa ngaphezulu. Noma into efanayo ibonakala ngendlela ehlukile ngaphezulu kuye ngokuthi ibekwe kanjani.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uthathe okwakuyisiyingi ngaphezulu lapho iqale ime. Uma ilele, ubuso obubheke phezulu buhlukile.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ibonakala njengezibuko ezimbili ezigqagqene. Ngoba kunobuso obubili, ingaphezulu nengaphansi.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Noma kunobuso obubili, ingaphezulu nengaphansi, uma ilele, lolo olubheke phezulu uhlangothi.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ibonakala njengonxantathu. Uma ilele, kuvela amagumbi aqondile.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Noma uyilalisa insika, akukho magumbi aqondile avelayo. Cabanga ngesimo owasibona ohlangothini.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Ibonakala njengonxande omude. Uma ilele, uhlangothi lubheke phezulu.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ucabange ukuthi isimo esibonwa ohlangothini ekuqaleni siba yisimo esibonwa ngaphezulu uma ilele.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.reflect: Umcabango wakho washintsha kanjani phakathi kwesikhathi lapho wawazi kuphela isimo esibonwa ngaphezulu nalapho wawazi nesimo esibonwa ohlangothini? Ukunciphisa izinto ezingenzeka, yini enye ulwazi olwaludingeka?
z-m-03-08.s.s2.prompt: Umngani wathi, "Ibonakale njengesiyingi ngaphezulu, ngakho libhola!" Yini enye ongayenza ukuthola ukuthi umngani wakho ulungile yini? Bhala nesizathu.
z-m-03-08.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga nokuthi insika ezungezayo ibonakala kanjani ngaphezulu.
z-m-03-08.s.s2.hint.1: Funa ukuthi ikhona yini indlela lapho ibhola nensika ezungezayo kubonakala kuhlukile.
z-m-03-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngendlela engiyichazile, ibhola nensika ezungezayo bangahlukaniswa ngempela?
z-m-03-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi kunenye into ebonakala ifana ngaphezulu?
z-m-03-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ucabange nangecala lapho umngani wakho engaba nelungile?
z-m-03-08.s.s2.model.0: Kumele ubheke nasohlangothini. Insika ezungezayo nayo ibonakala njengesiyingi ngaphezulu, ngakho kungenzeka ingabi yibhola.
z-m-03-08.s.s2.model.1: Ungaphendula into futhi ubheke kolunye uhlangothi. Isimo sethini nasso siyisiyingi ngaphezulu, ngakho awukwazi ukusho ngokuqinisekile ukuthi libhola.
